title: Your Triggers Are the Guides to Your Freedom
coreMove: Triggers become useful when they reveal needs or limits; freedom grows when you answer the message, make a repair, and stop obeying the first surge.

exampleSpecs.audience: Mathias, a project lead catching resentment before an email
exampleSpecs.stakes: One bitter message could punish the colleague instead of naming the missing boundary.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use anger, jealousy, and resentment as signals before sending a reaction.

exampleSpecs.audience: Sarah, a consultant distinguishing body information from fear
exampleSpecs.stakes: Cancelling too fast may confuse a gut signal with an invasive thought spiral.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Ground body sensation in the vagus reference while separating intuition from panic.

exampleSpecs.audience: Sebastien, a partner replacing soothing avoidance with actual care
exampleSpecs.stakes: Another night of distraction would leave the physical need untouched.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show sleep, nourishment, and clean environment as direct need-meeting.

exampleSpecs.audience: Berthe, an artist reading jealousy as blocked desire
exampleSpecs.stakes: Judging the winner would hide the project Berthe has not permitted herself to pursue.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Translate jealousy and resentment into a permitted desire.

exampleSpecs.audience: Hyun, a manager separating repair guilt from old burden
exampleSpecs.stakes: A vague self-attack could replace the specific apology the trainee needs.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the 8 emotion signals to separate guilt, anger, and resentment.

exampleSpecs.domain: wellness appointment after a deadline sprint
exampleSpecs.audience: Severin, a designer noticing that purchased relief is not the same as care
exampleSpecs.stakes: Buying comfort could hide the lack of sleep and nourishment causing the crash.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Contrast pleasant support with sleep, nourishment, and posture or massage support.
